title: Spicy Mexican Tagine Stew
description: A twist on traditional Mexican cuisine, this spicy stew is made with the unique flavors of Egyptian spices, gooey cheese, and tangy olives.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add eggplant and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add chili powder and cumin; cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add Tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add sliced olives and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in sour cream and cook until heated through.
Transfer to a serving dish and top with shredded cheese.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 10-12 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
